categories.main_business_segments: Pony Testing International Group Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the testing, inspection, and certification industry, covering comprehensive technical services including life sciences and health environmental protection, automotive and other consumer products, safety assurance, and electronic and electrical products. The company provides integrated one-stop quality infrastructure services such as testing, metrology calibration, inspection, certification, and evaluation across multiple sectors including biomedicine, new energy vehicles, special industries, and environmental monitoring.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as ultra-high performance liquid chromatography, mass spectrometry, toxicology and pathology labs with SPF-grade experimental animals, electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) testing, 5G new radio testing platforms, and battery safety testing systems. It employs rigorous scientific methods and standards including CMA, CNAS, GLP certifications, and international standards for testing and quality assurance. The company also integrates AI and big data technologies to enhance testing efficiency and quality management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Pony Testing serves a broad customer base including manufacturers, traders, regulatory authorities, and end-users across industries such as pharmaceuticals, medical devices, food and beverages, agriculture, automotive (including new energy vehicles), cosmetics, electronics, environmental protection, and special equipment sectors. Its services support government agencies, large enterprises, and small to medium-sized businesses requiring compliance and quality assurance testing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with over 30 laboratory bases and nearly 100 subsidiaries and branches nationwide, including major hubs in Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Wuhan, Qingdao, Zhengzhou, Xi'an, and other key economic regions. It also has a presence in Hong Kong and serves international clients, with testing reports recognized in over 100 countries and regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Pony Testing operates primarily as a downstream service provider in the quality assurance supply chain, offering third-party testing, inspection, certification, and related technical services. It supports upstream manufacturers and downstream regulatory bodies by validating product quality, safety, and compliance throughout the product lifecycle.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes R&D innovation as a core strategic priority, focusing on advancing testing technologies in biomedicine (CRO/CDMO services), new energy vehicles, special industries, and environmental monitoring. It invests in AI and digital transformation to build a one-stop digital testing platform, enhance data utilization, and improve operational efficiency. The company also actively participates in standard-setting and collaborates with academic and research institutions to develop cutting-edge testing methods and solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through fees for testing, inspection, calibration, certification, and related technical services provided to clients. The company operates on a direct sales model, delivering services via sample receipt or on-site sampling, followed by testing and reporting. It also earns income from government contracts, consulting, and limited equipment sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Pony Testing is one of the earliest and leading third-party testing institutions in China, recognized as a market leader with comprehensive qualifications and strong government and industry endorsements. It competes with numerous domestic and international testing organizations in a fragmented and competitive market, leveraging its extensive service network, technical capabilities, and brand reputation to maintain a leading position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.54 billion, a 37.54% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 356 million. The company has a large asset base exceeding RMB 3.8 billion and employs nearly 6,000 staff. Despite recent revenue declines and profitability challenges due to strategic restructuring and investment in new business areas, the company continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D to support long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Pony Testing emphasizes its comprehensive one-stop quality infrastructure service platform, extensive national laboratory network, and strong technical expertise across multiple industries. It differentiates itself through high-level certifications (CMA, CNAS, GLP), government and industry recognition, and the ability to provide integrated testing, calibration, certification, and evaluation services. The company’s commitment to innovation, digital transformation, and customer-centric solutions underpins its value proposition of delivering reliable, efficient, and authoritative testing services that support clients’ compliance and quality assurance needs.
